subject: no std::cout or std::cerr in C++ API

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: no std::cout or std::cerr in C++ API
parts:
Here's the issue, which explains why we shouldn't use
cout and cerr and how it can be fixed:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/382

I assigned myself to fix it, but please don't add any
more instances in the future!

For terminology, I've been trying to stick to:

Stan C++ API --- basic C++ code used across interfaces
CmdStan --- command-line interfance
RStan --- R interface
PyStan --- Python interface

- Bob

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: no std::cout or std::cerr in C++ API

You might add a git hook to the Jenkins machine that git greps for std::cout and std::cerr in the commits before running the tests on a pull request.

Ben
